stories.description: Hackers are exploiting a high-severity flaw in Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS that allows authenticated attackers to run code with root privileges on affected firewalls.

stories.title: Multiple NGINX Flaws Let Remote Attackers Crash Servers and Execute Malicious Code
stories.description: F5 has disclosed three serious security flaws in NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source that can let remote, unauthenticated attackers crash worker processes by sending crafted HTTP requests.

stories.title: Hackers Backdoor Nextcloud Servers Through Critical Flaw in Collabora’s Built-in CODE App
stories.description: Attackers planted web shells through Collabora's Built-in CODE app while its document server was down; versions before 26.4.303 are affected.
